english.meaning: each, every or various, covering all the individual members
english.note: 各人 means everyone; 各種 means all kinds.

exampleSentences.english: But everyone has their own opinion.
exampleSentences.traditional: 不過見就各人有各人嘅意見𠸏。

exampleSentences.traditional: 返到屋企見到各人都重係瞓𡁵啊。
